integrity_notes: The argument is self-contained and covers all d>=2, k>=1, and 1<=ell<=d-1.
Exact finite checks provide corroboration only; no independent audit or historical-priority certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only unimodular simplices (and their integer-affine lattice equivalents), all positive integer dilations.
The contradiction concerns an exact-degree d minus ell prediction, not a possible upper-bound degree interpretation.
Does not classify optimal sections of arbitrary lattice polytopes or prove the general eventual quasipolynomial conjecture.
Historical originality is provisional, particularly against potentially unindexed equivalent lattice-section lemmas.
Maximizers are boundary faces; a different question restricting to transverse/interior sections is not addressed.
title: Maximal lattice-point sections of dilated unimodular simplices are exactly their faces
